items.title: CommunityStore (the class that actually talks to Postgres) has zero automated coverage
items.premise: Session 76 added tests for src/community/server.js, but every one of those tests passes a hand-rolled `store` mock — the real CommunityStore class in src/community/communityStore.js that computes the participant abuse rate limit, dedupes via ON CONFLICT, hashes participants with a pepper, prunes retention, and truncates oversized snapshots is never instantiated or exercised by any test. Its constructor hardcodes `new Pool(...)`, which blocks unit testing without a real database.
evidence: src/community/communityStore.js lines 28-30 (Pool hardcoded in constructor, no injection seam)
src/community/communityStore.js lines 72-98 (ingest: 480/hour abuse-limit math, ON CONFLICT dedupe)
src/community/communityStore.js lines 114-126 (snapshot: 60s cache TTL, MAX_SNAPSHOT_ROWS truncation flag)
src/community/communityStore.js lines 11-21 (loadPepper: ENOENT-then-write-then-reread, EEXIST race tolerance)
grep -rn communityStore|CommunityStore test/ returns no matches
items.constraint: Must not require a real Postgres in CI or change runtime behavior of the live service; inject a fake pool object satisfying the `.query`/`.connect`/`.end` surface CommunityStore actually calls.
verification: constructor accepts an injected pool and stops constructing its own Pool when one is provided
ingest() rejects with status 429 once the 1-hour participant count + new events exceeds 480
ingest() reports accepted vs duplicates correctly through ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
snapshot() reuses cache within the 60s TTL and bypasses it when force is true
snapshot() sets truncated=true only when row count exceeds MAX_SNAPSHOT_ROWS
loadPepper() reads an existing pepper file, and on ENOENT writes+rereads one; a simulated EEXIST on write does not throw

L1.recipe: Add pool injection seam only, no new tests.

L2.recipe: Add pool injection seam plus direct tests for ingest's rate limit/dedupe, snapshot's cache/truncation, and loadPepper's ENOENT/EEXIST paths using a fake pool and fake fs where needed.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a concurrent-ingest race test and a fuzzed retention-window boundary test.

items.executionEvidence: Added a `pool` constructor-injection seam to CommunityStore (src/community/communityStore.js) that falls back to a real pg.Pool only when no pool is supplied. Added test/community-store.test.js (11 tests) covering: injected-pool construction, the databaseUrl-required guard, ingest's accept/duplicate accounting via ON CONFLICT, the 480/hour 429 abuse limit, snapshot's 60s cache TTL and force-bypass, the truncation status boundary, deleteParticipant's scoping and cache invalidation, cleanupIfDue's 6-hour gate, hashParticipant's determinism, and loadPepper's ENOENT-then-write-then-reread bootstrap. All 11 pass against a FakePool with no real Postgres.
